title: 艾克·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 少年留着高耸白色莫霍克发，浅色面纹与背部时间装置清楚可辨。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ekko is a dark-skinned teenage inventor with a tall white mohawk, a pale painted face marking, a red scarf, and a distinctive time device secured on his back. Preserve his teenage age and lean adolescent proportions rather than making him an older muscular adult. His layered Zaun jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots fully cover him, while his bat-like tool stays lowered.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: white hair, scarf red, teal, copper city light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
